## History

Katie Maurice was created by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as an imaginary little girl who lived inside the reflection of a bookcase door. While [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was living at Mrs. Thomas's house, Katie served as her primary comfort and consolation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--katie-maurice.md)

Katie Maurice is [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's imaginary friend, whom [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) envisions living inside the glass doors of a bookcase. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confides in her and uses this imagined companionship to cope with her lonely surroundings.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014)_

- Friend of — imaginary friend in a bookcase  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014)</sub>
